name: Desert Oasis
living: the enormous full moon glows with a soft, slowly breathing halo
stars twinkle across the whole sky, with a rare shooting star
the camel caravan plods slowly along the dune ridge
lantern-lit windows in the adobe village flicker like candles
the moon and lantern reflections ripple on the palm-ringed lake (glow + field shimmer)
palm fronds sway gently in the night breeze
the tallest spire's beacon twinkles, the minaret lights glow
the HOME RUN DERBY board's lights chase slowly
a faint wisp of sand drifts off the dune crest now and then
crowd shimmer in the stands, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
